newsitem.title: USA: Syncor wins 4-yr deal valued at $270 mln.
newsitem.headline: Syncor wins 4-yr deal valued at $270 mln.

text.p: Syncor International Corp on Friday said it has signed a contract with health care service provider VHA Inc that could bring as much as $270 million in sales to Syncor over its four years.
The new contract calls for Syncor to supply unit-dose and bulk radiopharmaceutical drugs to VHA for distribution among the more than 1,300 health care providers VHA services.
The new contract took effect Jan. 1, 1997. It supersedes a three-year contract that expired on Dec. 31, 1996 and is the largest hospital alliance deal Syncor has been awarded.
